scope: Original-ABI Darwin diagnostic implementation, not a hardware runtime or GPU error recovery implementation.

kernel_sdk_operations.operation: Actual bounded snprintf PCI/severity/Xid prefix formatting through the pinned IOLib declaration.
kernel_sdk_operations.admission: Independent compiled SDK operation, compared with actual bridge imports; not an observed-symbol allowlist.

contracts.anchor: int NV_API_CALL nv_dev_vprintf(struct nv_state_t *nv, NV_LOG_LEVEL level, const char *printf_format, va_list arglist)
contracts.behavior: Actual device-scoped system log, original-state PCI identity and mapped severity; absent nv_state emits nothing as in original; invalid format rejected; returns actual bounded bytes supplied to log.
contracts.limits: 1024-byte stack message including terminating NUL; truncation count is actual emitted bytes; no dynamic allocation. Kernel stack execution remains gated.

contracts.behavior: Actual device-scoped Xid report to Darwin system log; validates state and format; success means log submission, not recovery or GPU health.
contracts.port_policy: Darwin system log replaces original Linux tracepoint delivery. Linux vendor error-subscriber registration and CONFIG_CRAY_XT forwarding are not exposed by this port.

contracts.anchor: void NV_API_CALL os_bug_check(NvU32 bugCode, const char *bugCodeStr)
contracts.behavior: Fatal kernel panic, never a successful return; bug text always a string argument rather than format. Native control uses actual abort.

validation.exact_abi: C facade includes pinned original declarations before definitions; compile-time __builtin_types_compatible_p checks all three exact function-pointer types.
validation.local_clang_18: passed ordinary and fatal address,undefined,function sanitizers
